🎬 Replay API

Session replay data storage and retrieval for user experience monitoring

Base URL

{{.BaseURL}}/v1/replay

Endpoints

POST /v1/replay/sessions

Create a new replay session

Headers

Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>

Request Body

{
  "session_id": "sess_01234567890abcdef",
  "user_id": "user_12345",
  "url": "https://example.com/dashboard",
  "user_agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10_15_7)...",
  "viewport": {
    "width": 1920,
    "height": 1080
  },
  "metadata": {
    "environment": "production",
    "version": "1.2.3",
    "feature_flags": ["new_ui", "analytics_v2"]
  }
}

Response

HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "session_id": "sess_01234567890abcdef",
  "upload_url": "https://upload.playback.com/v1/replay/sess_01234567890abcdef/events",
  "expires_at": "2024-01-01T01:00:00Z"
}

POST /v1/replay/{session_id}/events

Upload replay events for a session

Headers

Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <api-key>
Content-Encoding: gzip (optional)

Request Body

Array of replay events in rrweb format

[
  {
    "type": 0,
    "data": {
      "node": {
        "type": 0,
        "childNodes": [{
          "type": 1,
          "tagName": "html",
          "attributes": {"lang": "en"},
          "childNodes": [...]
        }]
      }
    },
    "timestamp": 1640995200000
  },
  {
    "type": 2,
    "data": {
      "node": {
        "id": 123,
        "tagName": "button",
        "attributes": {"class": "btn-primary"}
      },
      "nextId": 456
    },
    "timestamp": 1640995201000
  },
  {
    "type": 3,
    "data": {
      "source": 2,
      "type": 0,
      "id": 123,
      "x": 150,
      "y": 300
    },
    "timestamp": 1640995202000
  }
]

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "events_received": 1547,
  "events_processed": 1547,
  "session_duration_ms": 45000
}

GET /v1/replay/{session_id}

Retrieve session replay data

Query Parameters

  • start - Start time offset (ms) within session
  • end - End time offset (ms) within session
  • format - Response format: rrweb, compressed (default: rrweb)

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "session_id": "sess_01234567890abcdef",
  "user_id": "user_12345",
  "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "duration_ms": 45000,
  "url": "https://example.com/dashboard",
  "viewport": {
    "width": 1920,
    "height": 1080
  },
  "events": [{
    "type": 0,
    "data": {...},
    "timestamp": 1640995200000
  }],
  "metadata": {
    "event_count": 1547,
    "errors": 3,
    "clicks": 42,
    "scrolls": 89
  }
}

GET /v1/replay/sessions

List and search replay sessions

Query Parameters

  • user_id - Filter by user ID
  • url - Filter by URL (supports wildcards)
  • start - Start time (RFC3339)
  • end - End time (RFC3339)
  • min_duration - Minimum session duration (ms)
  • max_duration - Maximum session duration (ms)
  • has_errors - Filter sessions with errors (true/false)
  • limit - Result limit (max 1000, default 50)
  • offset - Pagination offset

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sessions": [{
    "session_id": "sess_01234567890abcdef",
    "user_id": "user_12345",
    "url": "https://example.com/dashboard",
    "created_at": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "duration_ms": 45000,
    "event_count": 1547,
    "error_count": 3,
    "viewport": {
      "width": 1920,
      "height": 1080
    }
  }],
  "total": 2847,
  "has_more": true
}

GET /v1/replay/{session_id}/heatmap

Generate interaction heatmap data for a session

Query Parameters

  • type - Heatmap type: clicks, scrolls, moves (default: clicks)
  • viewport_width - Normalize to viewport width
  • viewport_height - Normalize to viewport height

Response

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "session_id": "sess_01234567890abcdef",
  "type": "clicks",
  "viewport": {
    "width": 1920,
    "height": 1080
  },
  "points": [{
    "x": 150,
    "y": 300,
    "intensity": 5,
    "timestamp": 1640995202000
  }, {
    "x": 200,
    "y": 450,
    "intensity": 12,
    "timestamp": 1640995205000
  }],
  "total_interactions": 42
}

DELETE /v1/replay/{session_id}

Delete a replay session (GDPR compliance)

Response

HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

Event Types

Type 0 - DomContentLoaded

Full DOM snapshot when recording starts

Type 1 - Load

Page load complete event

Type 2 - FullSnapshot

Full DOM snapshot during recording

Type 3 - IncrementalSnapshot

DOM mutations, mouse movements, input changes

Type 4 - Meta

Viewport changes, media interactions

Type 5 - Custom

Custom application events

Data Retention

  • Standard plan: 30 days
  • Pro plan: 90 days
  • Enterprise plan: Custom retention period
  • GDPR deletion: Immediate upon request

Rate Limits

  • Session creation: 1,000/hour per API key
  • Event upload: 10MB/second per session
  • Session retrieval: 100/minute per API key
  • Maximum session duration: 2 hours
  • Maximum events per session: 1,000,000

Privacy & Security

🔒 Data Masking

Automatic PII redaction in form fields and sensitive elements

🛡️ GDPR Compliance

Right to deletion, data portability, and consent management

🔐 Encryption

End-to-end encryption for replay data at rest and in transit

📍 Geolocation

Optional recording with user consent for location-based insights
